name: scope-ledger
description: Per-worktree scope ledger (.claude/scope-ledger.local.md) with four fail-open hooks: the first source edit without a ledger is denied once; review / scan / audit skills inject a finding-triage policy and count rounds; a Stop with open in-scope items is blocked once per state; SessionStart replays the ledger after compaction. Keeps review-driven work from expanding past the original request.
